主要内容: The Registrant replaced its existing $1.5 billion 364-Day Credit Agreement and $2.25 billion Four-Year Credit Agreement with new facilities. The new $1.5 billion 364-Day facility expires on March 13, 2015, replacing the previous agreement that expired on March 14, 2014. The new $2.25 billion Five-Year facility expires in March 2019, replacing the previous Four-Year agreement set to expire in February 2015. Both new facilities allow borrowing at LIBOR-based rates with spreads subject to debt rating caps and floors. They include one financial covenant on interest coverage and exclude entities like Euro Disney and Shanghai Disney Resort from certain obligations. The updated agreements are filed as Exhibits 10.1 and 10.2, respectively.
